name: MCMC-based 3DGS / SGLD for 3DGS
definition: Reformulates 3D Gaussian Splatting by treating the set of 3D Gaussians as random samples drawn from an underlying probability distribution describing the scene, specifically as Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) samples.
summary: MCMC-based 3DGS reformulates Gaussian Splatting as Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics, replacing manual densification heuristics with probabilistic state transitions and noise-driven exploration.
